Class Qwen3ChatTemplate

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.template.Qwen3ChatTemplate
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChatTemplate
public final class Qwen3ChatTemplate extends Object implements ChatTemplate
Java port of the Qwen3 / Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.8 chat_template.jinja tool-calling path (XML <tool_call> format).

Reference: Hugging Face Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B chat template.
